value: children refuse to enter Main Alley Spiral; report seeing a 'black shadow' with no face

quote: When she walked the alleys people made room in a practiced way, part respect and part calculation. Neighbors pressed to the lip of the spiral as Mercy reached it — faces like coins, mouths that had learned the economy of rumor.
They had made a small crowd of the spiral — the way a wound gathers curious hands.

value: pots/clattering observed in the communal kitchen; children refusing to eat; boy whispering name
quote: "Pots are falling off shelves," said Neighbor Lei, the words sharp as a scrape of tin. "The boy keeps whispering that name. Mei won't eat."

value: anxious, watchful; neighbors gather and observe from windows
quote: The yard's edges filled with the small witnesses of a city too close to its own wounds. Someone leaned from a second-story window and watched as if drawn by a moth to light; a child peered from behind a shutter, finger pressed to lips.

value: anxious; watchers present from roofs and windows
quote: Neighbors watched from windows and doorways, children peered round shutters, and many stayed in place to see what would happen...

value: some neighbors display recoil gestures (snapped shutter, neighbor retreating)
quote: A few gestures betrayed the night's danger: a shutter snapped closed with a hard click; a neighbor on a nearby roof retreated half a step and then drew back behind a low wall.

value: tight, careful attention; increased community burden
quote: As they climbed back out of the stairwell, the neighborhood watched with a tight, careful attention. The discovery had given the spirit a new face to name and the community a new burden to carry.
